title: holcus mollis subsp. triflorus
intro: Holcus mollis subsp. triflorus, commonly known as Darnel or Creeping Soft-grass, is a subspecies of perennial grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, as it is known to have health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Holcus mollis subsp. triflorus include its use as a diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic agent, making it a popular remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
